exposure: Women diagnosed with placenta previa or PAS (cohort 2, n = 227)
Women with a suspected cup-shaped placenta (cohort 1, n = 339)
outcome: detection rate of placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: Women attending routine mid-pregnancy obstetric ultrasound at the Sahlgrenska University Hospital between 2013 and 2017.
finding: The existing routine mid-pregnancy obstetric ultrasound screening showed a low detection rate for placenta previa (49%) and PAS (25%), suggesting that adding risk factors could improve the detection rate.
